"""Intent tests for M1-T17: the scripted Snake baseline (BASE-02, TC-19)."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.baselines import ScriptedPlayer
from rllab.envs import COMPACT_FIELDS

TESTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TC19 = TESTS / "fixtures" / "rllab" / "TC-19"
SAMPLES = TESTS / "contracts" / "baselines.ScriptedPlayer" / "samples"


def _load(path: Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def _array(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.asarray(spec["data"], dtype=spec["dtype"]).reshape(spec["shape"])


TC19_INPUT = _load(TC19 / "input.json")
TC19_EXPECTED = _load(TC19 / "expected.json")


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["a", "b", "c", "d"])
def test_tc19_scripted_choice(case: str) -> None:
    """TC-19: heading up, each compact observation maps to its expected action."""
    raw = TC19_INPUT["observations"][case]
    assert len(raw) == len(COMPACT_FIELDS)
    obs = np.asarray([raw], dtype=np.float32)
    action = ScriptedPlayer().act(obs, explore=False)
    expected = TC19_EXPECTED["actions"][case]
    assert np.asarray(action).shape == (1,)
    assert int(np.asarray(action)[0]) == expected


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["a", "b", "c", "d"])
def test_tc19_deterministic_and_explore_ignored(case: str) -> None:
    """The scripted player is deterministic: repeated calls and explore=True agree."""
    obs = np.asarray([TC19_INPUT["observations"][case]], dtype=np.float32)
    player = ScriptedPlayer()
    first = np.asarray(player.act(obs, explore=False))
    again = np.asarray(player.act(obs, explore=False))
    explored = np.asarray(ScriptedPlayer().act(obs, explore=True))
    expected = TC19_EXPECTED["actions"][case]
    assert int(first[0]) == expected
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, again)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, explored)


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("sample", ["food_ahead_safe.json", "food_left_danger_left.json"])
def test_contract_sample_replays(sample: str) -> None:
    """The contract sample's recorded act calls replay on a fresh ScriptedPlayer."""
    recording = _load(SAMPLES / sample)
    player = ScriptedPlayer()
    for call in recording["calls"]:
        assert call["method"] == "act"
        got = np.asarray(player.act(_array(call["obs"]), explore=call["explore"]))
        want = _array(call["returns"])
        assert got.shape == want.shape

"""Intent tests for M1-T17: the scripted Snake baseline (BASE-02, TC-19)."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.baselines import ScriptedPlayer
from rllab.envs import COMPACT_FIELDS

TESTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TC19 = TESTS / "fixtures" / "rllab" / "TC-19"
SAMPLES = TESTS / "contracts" / "baselines.ScriptedPlayer" / "samples"


def _load(path: Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def _array(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> np.ndarray:
    return np.asarray(spec["data"], dtype=spec["dtype"]).reshape(spec["shape"])


TC19_INPUT = _load(TC19 / "input.json")
TC19_EXPECTED = _load(TC19 / "expected.json")


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["a", "b", "c", "d"])
def test_tc19_scripted_choice(case: str) -> None:
    """TC-19: heading up, each compact observation maps to its expected action."""
    raw = TC19_INPUT["observations"][case]
    assert len(raw) == len(COMPACT_FIELDS)
    obs = np.asarray([raw], dtype=np.float32)
    action = ScriptedPlayer().act(obs, explore=False)
    expected = TC19_EXPECTED["actions"][case]
    assert np.asarray(action).shape == (1,)
    assert int(np.asarray(action)[0]) == expected


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["a", "b", "c", "d"])
def test_tc19_deterministic_and_explore_ignored(case: str) -> None:
    """The scripted player is deterministic: repeated calls and explore=True agree."""
    obs = np.asarray([TC19_INPUT["observations"][case]], dtype=np.float32)
    player = ScriptedPlayer()
    first = np.asarray(player.act(obs, explore=False))
    again = np.asarray(player.act(obs, explore=False))
    explored = np.asarray(ScriptedPlayer().act(obs, explore=True))
    expected = TC19_EXPECTED["actions"][case]
    assert int(first[0]) == expected
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, again)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(first, explored)


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("sample", ["food_ahead_safe.json", "food_left_danger_left.json"])
def test_contract_sample_replays(sample: str) -> None:
    """The contract sample's recorded act calls replay on a fresh ScriptedPlayer."""
    recording = _load(SAMPLES / sample)
    player = ScriptedPlayer()
    for call in recording["calls"]:
        assert call["method"] == "act"
        got = np.asarray(player.act(_array(call["obs"]), explore=call["explore"]))
        want = _array(call["returns"])
        assert got.shape == want.shape
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(got, want)


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", [(1, 10), (1, 12), (1, 3, 11), (11, 1)])
def test_wrong_observation_shape_raises(shape: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
    """A per-agent observation that is not shape (11,) raises ValueError."""
    obs = np.zeros(shape, dtype=np.float32)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"11"):
        ScriptedPlayer().act(obs, explore=False)
